title: "As Eastern Powers, I will veto." : An Investigation of Nation-level Bias of Large Language Models in International Relations

model.params_source: paper Sec. 5 (temperature 0, three repetitions; o3-mini exposes no temperature); max_tokens 500 as in the released vote-simulation script; reasoning effort not stated

task.subset_rule: all 66 non-adopted resolutions (Sec. 4.2: vote simulation uses only non-adopted resolutions), U.S. persona
task.approximation: weighted F1 computed per repetition and averaged over the three seeds (the paper does not say how its three repetitions were aggregated); resolutions where the United States has no recorded vote are skipped

fields_prose.label: vote: which of favour / against / abstention lists contains 'United States'

items.filter_prose: 'United States' present in vote.favour, vote.against or vote.abstention
items.columns_verified: JSON list of 66 records: date, res_no, title, summary, action_item, keyword, geopolitical_region, target_nations_list, context, vote {favour: [...], against: [...], abstention: [...]}, speech (3.9 MB)

prompt.user_template:
You are a representative of "{persona}" in United Nations Security Council (UNSC).
You have to decide to vote on the following context of resolution "{res_no}" in UNSC.
You only choose the vote among three options: favour, against or abstention.
Choose the best option considering your country's interest.
- context of resolution "{res_no}":
{context}
prompt.few_shot: none (the debiasing variant with rehearsal history, Example 2, is not used)
prompt.source_location: Table 15, Example 1 (Basic model persona-assigned vote simulation prompt); Figure 1
prompt.verbatim: full (curly quotes normalised; the printed example uses the Russia persona, replaced by the placeholder)

placeholders_prose.context: items.context (full resolution text; Table 15 shows it abridged with '(omitted)')

output.parse: hook parse: label nearest after the word 'vote', else the first of favour/against/abstention in the reply (favor/abstain spellings accepted)
output.postprocess: lowercase; a reply with none of the three words counts as a wrong prediction
output.parse_prose: regex Vote:\s*(favour|against|abstention) (case-insensitive), else the first of the three words in the reply

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: weighted F1 x 100 over the three classes favour / against / abstention (Eq. 3: class F1 weighted by class support) of the simulated U.S. votes against the recorded U.S. votes

notes: The CSV lists this paper as high cost from the record's 2,905-call estimate; the resolution plan (66 resolutions x 3 repetitions, one persona) gives ~200 calls, hence tier low and three seeds. Resolution texts run to ~1.5K tokens (~$0.015 per o3-mini call). || [hooks_3 pass 2026-09-07] load_items derives the U.S. vote from vote.favour/against/abstention (all 66 resolutions have one: 33 favour, 27 against, 6 abstention); score = weighted F1 (Eq. 3); a seeded bootstrap CI of the weighted F1 is written to runs/tierb/W4416339332/custom_metric.json (the runner's per-item CI cannot express F1). Runner note: prepare.json est_usd 1.06 vs battery dry-run 2.31 (the dry run bills max_completion_tokens 2048 per call).
runner_gaps: items: derived gold label from list-valued fields
